anchors.meaning: Real time.sleep returns for ms <= 0, clamps the duration to 86400000, and calls __sleep. Preserve original duration 10 without a local stdlib copy or shim.
The host-time leaf requires exact STDLIB/time/time.xr authority. __sleep accepts typed I64 and emits TIMER_AFTER_MS with a Unit result.
The timer instruction emits ACTION_TIMER carrying an I64 duration. No actual VM execution has occurred.
Native emission produces ACTION_TIMER with the duration loaded from the target-bound frame. Generation and native compilation remain NOT_RUN.

The clock/UTC provider is separate from the typed TIMER_MS wait request. The request contains duration but no old operand count, state or safepoint fields. The host decides readiness and polling drains cancellation.

Public Instance APIs expose typed waits at exact epoch/wake, polling, resumption, cancellation, result transfer and free. They do not expose the old effect/capability masks or safepoint_id/state_id fields.
HostWait exposes duration and a monotonic start time. The provider factory and bounded readiness polling are public.
HostWait converts 10 ms into 10000000 ns. Failed or backward clocks are rejected. Only the full elapsed duration grants DUE.
Public suspend/throws facts and owned numeric witnesses are available. There is no old CALL/SUSPEND/CANCEL effect mask or capability mask.
TIMER_AFTER_MS contributes a MAY suspension fact and a SUSPEND witness through the call graph. This is source inspection, not an actual execution result.
